description: This file defines a template class for handling enumerations with string conversion capabilities, including macros for enumeration conversion tables and helper functions for string matching and conversion.

classes.name: EnumerateType
classes.description: A template class that encapsulates an enumeration value and provides string conversion, comparison, and assignment functionalities.

classes.name: EnumerateConversion
classes.description: A helper struct that associates an enumeration value with its string name and length.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator overloads for assigning enumeration values, strings, and other EnumerateType instances.

methods.name: IsSet
methods.description: Checks if the enumeration value is set.

methods.name: Data
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the enumeration value.
